punchline: Schmidt said he needed no help; Campbell asked about his problems.
thirty_sec: When Eric Schmidt became Google's CEO in 2001, John Doerr suggested Bill Campbell. Schmidt's first reaction was 'I don't need any help.' Campbell asked about Google's most interesting problems; by 2008 Schmidt said his contribution was 'literally not possible to overstate.'
question: Who around you resists your help, and what is the most interesting problem on their plate?
key_contrast: Starting with their problems versus starting with your advice.
